title: Register a private or public company (IN01)
text:
If you use your home address as the company’s registered office address, it will be available to the public.

 See our guidance on what information we make publicly available .

 You must verify your identity to prove who your are. See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 You can register a private limited company online . Our online service costs £100.

 Using a paper form IN01

 It costs £124 to send a paper application to register a private or public company.

 Your forms must be printed at full size on white A4 paper.

 It takes longer to process paper documents sent by post.

 Continuation pages

 The continuation pages are optional. Use them if you need to provide more details.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
